def: Absence or lack of intelligence; unwisdom; ignorance. Bp. Hall.
The process of removing the vitreous glaze from porcelain,leaving the dull luster of the surface of ivory porcelian. Knight.
Of or pertaining to the Oscines.
A young fellow; a younker. [Obs. or Colloq.] Sir W. Scott.
The quality or state of being liquid; liquidity; fluency.
Something which excites distaste or disgust. [Obs.] Speed.
One who, or that which, infuses.
Crystallized cawk, in which the crystals are small.
The technical name of lead. See Lead.
